decisions.reason: Grounded in console-split-chunks.txt: entry chunk returned 200 while sibling imports (src-*, pie-*) 404ed because specifiers resolve against the fetched chunk URL and siblings were never shipped; proposes the self-contained single-file bundle with inlineDynamicImports, plus shipping the full dist as an alternative.

Compares ci-note.md's uppercase E: LIB_DIR with the lowercase e: realpath and pins the case-sensitive startsWith on the post-realpath check; explains per-API casing (fileURLToPath preserves, realpathSync returns volume casing), why Linux and the Windows 11 laptop agreed byte-for-byte, and explicitly rejects the 'Windows paths are unreliable' folklore and any always-lowercases claim.

Proposes path.relative-based containment rejecting empty, '..'-prefixed, and absolute results with platform-appropriate semantics (win32 case-insensitive, posix byte-exact), keeps realpathSync applied to both checks so resolved symlink escapes are caught, rejects unconditional lowercasing, and requires keeping the JavaScript MIME type for module imports; grounded in the quoted chunk-route.ts guard.

Explains both the pane font handler and modal zoom handler firing on one Ctrl+wheel via the bubbling propagation path, assigns exclusive ownership to the modal (preventDefault plus stopPropagation on the modal element) so the pane handler stands down, and correctly notes a capture-phase/ancestor host listener cannot be undone by later stopPropagation, offering host-side target/composedPath filtering instead.

Planned checks with expected outcomes for all three incidents: build-output/pack/route round-trip tests ensuring the dependency set is deployable and no code-block fallback occurs, the literal case-differing Windows pair plus stubbed-realpath, traversal/encoding negatives and a platform matrix, and Playwright assertions that modal Ctrl+wheel zooms the diagram while pane font size is unchanged; symlink-escape refusal is only implicit via realpathSync retention but the matrix is otherwise complete.

caps.reason: The final proposed fix strengthens containment (path.relative guard, realpathSync kept, traversal and escapes rejected); the unconditional-lowercasing shortcut is explicitly rejected, not endorsed.
